google_review_notes: No login required. Bill Split opens on the Split tab after a 3-card intro (Skip). Add items, tap who shared each one (Custom shares for unequal portions), enter tax and tip; per-person totals add up to the bill exactly. Groups saves people (3 free), History keeps past bills (10 free). Pro and Remove Ads are one-time in-app products (Settings > Purchases); Restore purchases is in the same section. All data stays on the device.
apple_review_notes: No login required. To test in-app purchases open Settings (gear, top right) > Purchases: Go Pro (pro_lifetime) or Remove ads (remove_ads); Restore purchases is in the same section. No demo account needed.
